summary: Medicus Pharma Ltd. filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, reporting that on September 11, 2026 it and YA II PN, Ltd. (Yorkville) mutually terminated their February 10, 2025 Standby Equity Purchase Agreement. The SEPA had allowed Medicus to issue and sell up to $15.0 million of common shares to Yorkville. At termination, no borrowings, advance notices, or shares remained outstanding, and no termination fees are owed by either party. Yorkville Securities remains a sales agent under the company's December 29, 2025 Equity Distribution Agreement, preserving an at-the-market financing channel. This is a routine financing-arrangement termination, not a special situation.
